title: DISTINCT of the key column returns the stored keys only

source.quote: DISTINCT does not return the blank row caused by an invalid relationship
source.supports: DISTINCT does not return the blank row

source.quote: the VALUES function treats the blank row as a regular row, returning it. On the other hand, DISTINCT never returns the blank row

derivation: Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so the relationship is invalid and Product gets a blank row. DISTINCT returns the stored keys 1, 2, 3 and not the blank row's BLANK. The orphan key 9 is a value of Sales[ProductKey], not of Product[ProductKey].
notes: VALUES ( Product[ProductKey] ) has a fourth row, BLANK: see isblank-on-blank-row-key.
